about.title: About Genshin Quiz
about.subtitle: A community space for exploring, answering, and sharing Genshin Impact knowledge
about.introduction: Genshin Quiz brings questions, polls, and challenges together in one place. Browse content in your preferred language, compare ideas with other Travelers, and turn your knowledge of Teyvat into a new challenge.
about.questions_desc: Answer single-choice, multiple-choice, and true-or-false questions across lore, characters, combat, and more. Take part in curated quizzes when you want a focused challenge.
about.polls_desc: Vote on community polls, see how other players responded, and share your own point of view on the world of Genshin Impact.
about.community_desc: Sign in to create questions and polls, then follow answer accuracy and creation activity on the rankings page.
about.step_one: Browse questions, polls, or quizzes that interest you.
about.step_two: Sign in to submit answers, vote, or create your own community content.
about.step_three: Check results, learn from explanations, and keep challenging yourself.
